tool: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, run through `codex exec` with the reference image attached
style: Original cozy gouache and colored-pencil rooms drawn to the default room's camera, composition and floor perspective; no game assets copied.
format: Generated as 1536x1024 PNG and stored as JPEG (quality 88, 4:4:4 chroma): the rooms are opaque, and six full-size PNGs would triple the download of the style shelf.
prompts: Game background for a cozy cottage life sim: ONE EMPTY ROOM seen straight-on from the front. Match the attached reference image exactly in camera, composition and painting style: a flat back wall fills the top two fifths of the picture; the floor fills the bottom three fifths and recedes in the same one-point perspective as the reference floor; the wall meets the floor in one straight horizontal baseboard line at about 41 percent of the height; a thin wooden corner post stands at the far left and far right edges. Same original hand-painted gouache and coloured-pencil look as the reference: soft light, fine cinnamon-brown outlines, visible paper grain, gentle window light patches on the floor. Landscape 3:2, the room fills the whole picture edge to edge with no border. The room is completely EMPTY: no furniture, no rugs, no pots or objects on the floor, no people, no animals, no text. Everything on the wall stays above the baseboard, and the floor is plain and uncluttered so furniture can be placed on it later. Ordinary countryside cottage architecture only: nothing magical, no glowing fantasy elements, no curved or organic walls, no domes, no clouds indoors. THEME: CREAM COTTAGE in daylight. Ivory and cream plaster wall with simple cream-painted wood panel wainscoting under a chair rail. Two tall arched wooden windows with white frames, placed like the windows in the reference, show a sunny garden and distant hills. Short sheer linen cafe curtains hang on thin brass rods. Between the windows hang two small framed pressed-flower pictures. Floor: honey-coloured oak laid in a herringbone parquet pattern, drawn in correct perspective.
